title: •Corellian Engineering Corporation
caption: •Corellian Engineering Corporation (V)
game_text: Deploy on table if {ovs:9} Watch Your Step on table. X = number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians. While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is +X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force (except from your card), may reduce loss by X. {alter}
game_text_lines:
Deploy on table if {ovs:9} Watch Your Step on table. X =
number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians.
While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is
+X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force
(except from your card), may reduce loss by X. {alter}
lore: Only one of the ‘Big Three’ starship manufacturers to sell primarily to civilians. CEC employees take great delight in calling their highly modifiable designs ‘stock’.

notes: Group: Everything Else. Bottom-half slip; banner EFFECT (no grabber box). Unique. INLINE ICON before 'Watch Your Step': purple/white/blue sphere = the Original Virtual Set 9 sphere (pixel-matched against assets/icons/ovs-set-9.png, best by far; Watch Your Step (V) is VS9 #24) → {ovs:9}; the stub drops it. Text ends with the red circle-slash A → {alter}. No icon column (only the VS16 sphere). CHANGES vs printed card (Special Edition): text replaced (printed: 'Deploy on Corellia system. All your freighters are deploy -1 and hyperspeed +1. Also, all your Quad Laser Cannons deploy free and add 2 to each of their weapon destiny draws. Suspended while opponent controls Corellia. (Immune to Alter.)'). LORE corrected from the scan: curly single quotes ‘Big Three’ and ‘stock’. (wiki straight). Base scan only 350 px; SE copyright line by set. Modern: VB4-L-corellianengineeringcorporation-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4). Slip text otherwise matches the stub.
